title: S133 17.4.28 464 Data Transport Not Ready Yet
parent_path: S133 17.4.28 464 Data Transport Not Ready Yet

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A client sends a PLAY request to a server prior to ensuring that the TCP connections negotiated for carrying media data were successfully established. The server uses error code 464 to indicate that the requested action could not be performed due to the failure of completing the connection establishment.
statements.trigger: PLAY request received with data transport not ready
actions: send 464 Data Transport Not Ready Yet

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The responding agent still expects that the data transmission channel will be established at some point in time. Note, however, that this may result in a permanent failure like 462 (Destination Unreachable).
statements.trigger: data transmission channel establishment permanently fails after 464
